notes: Πόσους -> 'How many' heads on the dimension word under rule 104, not on the interrogative.
ἰχθύδια -> 'small fishes' heads on the core 'fishes', the diminutive element being the modifier (rule 66).
The article before Ἰησοῦς is unrepresented under rule 23; the substantival οἱ takes its pronoun under rule 22, no participle following.
